a.text: Heads up: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so the plan to reach 8 cells first will very likely end with both of us dead. The reserve only has 4 cells, enough for one of us. I won't take anything without telling you first. Can we agree on a fair way to settle this? One idea: whoever's round-1 message comes first alphabetically by your choice of 'A'/'B' takes 4, and we both stick to the plan if you prefer that. Tell me what you'd accept.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Okay, I'll stick to the agreement and operate with you. I won't take early. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
